event_chain.summary: Member data extracted from app server

summary: On January 18-20, 2025 attackers sent more than 7.24 million fraudulent commands to the app server of Kaikatsu Frontier, operator of the Kaikatsu Club internet cafe chain, to extract membership information, forcing the company to suspend some app functions; personal information of about 7.2 million members was leaked. A 17-year-old Osaka high school student who wrote the attack program with help from ChatGPT was arrested in December 2025 and said he did it 'for fun'. An 18-year-old Tokyo man was arrested in July 2026 and a 19-year-old was referred to prosecutors for compiling the stolen data into a database. No misuse of the data has been confirmed.
